links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT answers to pediatric dentistry patient/parent questions (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level)
links.effect: ChatGPT answers were judged difficult to read for patients/parents. No significant readability differences were found between question groups or topics (p > 0.05). Numeric readability scores are not given in the abstract.
links.quote: ChatGPT, which is difficult to readability for patients/parents and offers an acceptable similarity rate, needs to be improved in order to interact with people more efficiently and fluently.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality, readability, and similarity of ChatGPT responses to pediatric dentistry questions across patient/parent and academic topics without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
